finalYaml:
trigger:
  enabled: false
pr:
  enabled: false
parameters:
- name: env
  type: string
  default: dev
  values:
  - dev
  - prod
- name: runTests
  type: boolean
  default: true
resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: templates
    type: git
    name: personal/atn-templates
    ref: refs/heads/main
stages:
- stage: build
  jobs:
  - job: info
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: 'tpl-version: v1'
      inputs:
        script: echo marker
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: 'ctx: reason=Manual branch=refs/heads/main myVar='
      inputs:
        script: echo ctx
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: prod-only
      inputs:
        script: echo prod
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: main-only
      inputs:
        script: echo main
- stage: local
  jobs:
  - job: local
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: 'local-version: v1b'
      inputs:
        script: echo local
